captions.formal: Vehicles move through a city intersection lined with yellow-leaved trees and apartment buildings. A sign for Espresso Restaurant is visible on a building to the left.
captions.sarcastic: A breathtaking display of urban efficiency, where the vehicles move so quickly they have simply ceased to be solid objects.
captions.humorous_tech: City traffic packets streaming through the intersection with high latency, while the Espresso Restaurant waits in the background to debug the morning.
captions.humorous_non_tech: Everyone is rushing past the Espresso Restaurant as if their lives depend on getting somewhere else exactly three minutes faster.

captions.formal: An orange, fluffy kitten walks forward across dirt ground in a wooded area surrounded by green leaves and thin brown branches.
captions.sarcastic: A truly daring explorer, conquering several inches of dirt and a few branches in one monumental journey toward the camera.
captions.humorous_tech: Orange kitten initiating a deployment to the camera, slowly moving forward through the woods to check if the environment is stable.
captions.humorous_non_tech: This orange fluff ball marches through the woods with the confidence of a tiny landlord coming to collect several overdue treats.

captions.formal: A woman with dark hair in a high bun types on a keyboard at a white office desk, positioned before a computer monitor.
captions.sarcastic: A masterclass in corporate intensity: a woman, a keyboard, and the sheer courage to actually type on a computer.
captions.humorous_tech: The woman begins typing with the quiet focus of someone trying to resolve a merge conflict before the morning standup.
captions.humorous_non_tech: She tackles the keys with the intense focus of a woman who knows exactly which coworker is getting a very sternly worded letter.

captions.formal: Water cascades over tiered dark rocks in a lush green forest, creating a white mist as the flow descends the rocky cliff face.
captions.sarcastic: Riveting cinema: a stationary camera capturing the daring ambition of water falling down some rocks.
captions.humorous_tech: Water cascading down these tiers with the absolute confidence of a developer pushing a massive update to production without a single unit test.
captions.humorous_non_tech: That water is sliding down those rocks with the reckless enthusiasm of a toddler who just discovered how a slide works.

captions.formal: A camera pans and zooms across a city skyline at dusk, moving from a building with a Google logo toward a curved tower with blue vertical lighting.
captions.sarcastic: A truly breathtaking journey, gliding past a Google logo just to spend an eternity staring at a curved building with blue lights.
captions.humorous_tech: The camera zooms past the Google logo toward a curved tower with the confidence of a developer deploying a hotfix directly to production.
captions.humorous_non_tech: The camera glides past the Google logo toward that curved tower like a tourist who has completely lost their hotel and is just pretending to admire the blue lights.

captions.formal: White and grey birds with red legs gather on a paved waterfront area. Some birds fly above a body of water and mountains before others walk across the pavement.
captions.sarcastic: A truly breathtaking display of ambition: two grey birds decide to walk across a pavement.
captions.humorous_tech: The birds in the sky finish their deployment to the pavement, while two grey arrivals trigger a merge conflict among the white ones.
captions.humorous_non_tech: The grey birds stroll into the group with the confidence of two newcomers who have absolutely no invitation to this party.

captions.formal: Pedestrians cross a crowded city intersection before clearing the street for a blue and white bus, two taxis, and a white truck labeled Jiggy.
captions.sarcastic: A truly efficient use of city planning: thousands of people rushing across an intersection just to make room for a truck called Jiggy.
captions.humorous_tech: The pedestrians execute a massive batch process across the intersection, successfully clearing the street before the buses and taxis deploy into production.
captions.humorous_non_tech: Everyone rushed across the street with the urgency of a flash sale, only to make way for a truck named Jiggy.

captions.formal: A person in lime green shoes kicks a white and blue Molten soccer ball on a green turf field at dusk as players run toward a goal.
captions.sarcastic: A masterclass in athletic strategy: three players sprint toward the goal while a fourth chooses the turf as their primary resting place.
captions.humorous_tech: Deploying a Molten ball to production with zero latency, while the goalie has already crashed and is currently unresponsive on the turf.
captions.humorous_non_tech: The lime green shoes send the ball flying while one player decides the turf is the perfect place for an unplanned nap.

captions.formal: Sautéed onions, mushrooms, and vegetables are tossed in a black frying pan over orange flames against a dark background.
captions.sarcastic: A breathtaking display of aviation, where a handful of vegetables momentarily believe they can fly before the pan inevitably brings them back to earth.
captions.humorous_tech: The chef executes a quick deploy of vegetables into the air, only for them to be merged back into the pan immediately.
captions.humorous_non_tech: The vegetables enjoy a brief moment of total freedom and flight before the pan reminds them exactly who is in charge.

captions.formal: Rain falls through green leaves and branches in an outdoor setting as the camera pans upward toward the sun, creating circular lens flares across the backlit scene.
captions.sarcastic: A cinematic masterpiece: the camera courageously pans upward just to be blinded by a few lens flares.
captions.humorous_tech: Panning upward toward the sun to trigger lens flares, like a developer intentionally crashing a system just to see if the error logs actually work.
captions.humorous_non_tech: The leaves are just trying to enjoy a shower, but the sun decided to crash the party and blind everyone.

captions.formal: A person wearing black-rimmed glasses stares forward against a dark background as blue and green digital code scrolls across the frame and reflects on the lenses.
captions.sarcastic: A breathtaking display of dynamism: a person remaining completely still while some digital code scrolls horizontally across their face.
captions.humorous_tech: The expression of someone staring into a production incident and waiting for the logs to finally reveal the bug.
captions.humorous_non_tech: He stares forward with the intense focus of a man trying to remember if he actually turned the oven off before leaving the house.
